text: 继内存、硬盘价格上涨后，电脑硬件市场又迎来新一轮价格波动。近日，记者走访深圳华强北市场发现，7月底以来，消费级显卡价格快速上涨，部分热门型号数日内涨价数百元，高端型号涨幅达到千元级别。多位受访商家及券商分析师认为，此轮显卡涨价主要由显存等上游核心物料成本上升所致。与此同时，部分AIC厂商暂停批量出货，渠道现货供应趋紧，进一步加剧了显卡价格波动。此外，经历此前内存涨价带来的库存压力后，华强北商家普遍采取订单驱动的采购方式，不愿贸然囤货。（上证报）
text_en: After memory and hard drive price increases, PC hardware market faces new price volatility. Recently, reporters visiting Shenzhen Huaqiangbei found consumer GPU prices rising rapidly since late July, with some popular models up hundreds of yuan in days, and high-end models seeing thousand-yuan increases. Multiple surveyed merchants and broker analysts believe this round of GPU price hikes is mainly driven by higher upstream core material costs like VRAM. Meanwhile, some AIC makers paused batch shipments, tightening channel spot supply, further amplifying GPU price swings. Additionally, after previous inventory pressure from memory price hikes, Huaqiangbei merchants generally adopt order-driven purchasing, unwilling to hoard stock. (Shanghai Securities News)
